text:
liz: Heads-up — we need to finalize launch bands for Payment Routing pilot (MVP vs v1). Aim: agree on cutlist & freeze strategy by EOD Wed so Eng can schedule the branch cut. High-level ask from customers: routing + failover reliability. Can we run a quick tradeoff thread here?

omar: SGTM. Draft proposal here: https://go/redwood/docs/payment-routing-bands (PROPOSAL v2) — will paste the cutlist below.

jess: From QA: MVP must include checkout happy path, token auth, and smoke metrics. Anything with SSO or tenant-level isolation should be v1.

rajesh: Eng callout: if we drop SSO to v1 we save ~2w of work. Main risk is billing API dependency (sales team) and PCI signoff for production traffic.

liz: Proposed cutlist (rough):
```
MVP:
 - core routing engine
 - token auth (not SSO)
 - basic retries + prefix KV cache
 - observability: request-level metrics + error budget alert
 - canary pipeline + basic canary gating
V1:
 - full SSO/SSAML
 - tenant isolation + data partitioning
 - advanced observability/tracing
 - billing integration + settlement workflow
```

omar: I'll convert that into a tracked ticket board. Known deps:
 - billing-api (sales) — ETA ~3d but possible blocker
 - PCI questionnaire — security needs answers, unknown lead time
 - regional infra for EU traffic — infra owning

jess: I'll own the QA checklist. Can we get a test harness for canary runs? Also need a small set of deterministic prompts for routing tests.

rajesh: Technical mitigation: if billing-api slips we can stub and feature-flag billing paths for MVP (adds a tech-debt ticket). Also can parallelize fraud checks as a background job.

liz: Action items:
 - omar: stakeholder sync tomorrow 10:00am (invite sent)
 - rajesh: estimate rollback & flag plan by EOD Tues
 - jess: QA canary harness + test vectors
 - me: send freeze reminder and finalize branch protection window (proposed Fri 17:00 UTC)

deploy-bot: Branch protection note — after Fri 17:00 UTC, merges require 2 approvals and passing canary checks.

liz: Quick thumbs poll — fine with Fri freeze and this cutlist? :thumbsup: / :thumbsdown:

omar: :thumbsup:

jess: :thumbsup:

rajesh: :thumbsup:
